storage: Keep in a dry airtight jar away from moisture; it clumps if damp.
looksLike: Pale pink to off-white crystals or fine powder; the tint comes from trace minerals.
howToPick: Check that the pack says fine powder if you want it for a khichdi; buy sealed packs from a known brand, as salt can be adulterated or damp.
